using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Duplicati.Library.Modules.Builtin;
using Xunit;

namespace Duplicati.Tests.Library.Modules.Builtin
{
    public class SendTelegramMessageTests
    {
        private class TestSendTelegramMessage : SendTelegramMessage
        {
            public string BotId { get => m_botid; set => m_botid = value; }
            public string ApiKey { get => m_apikey; set => m_apikey = value; }
            public string ChannelId { get => m_channelId; set => m_channelId = value; }
            public string TopicId { get => m_topicId; set => m_topicId = value; }

            // Expose the private SendMessageChunk method for testing via a public wrapper
            public Task SendMessageChunkPublic(string message, int partNumber, int totalParts)
            {
                return SendMessageChunk(message, partNumber, totalParts);
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task SendMessageChunk_ThrowsException_WhenBotIdIsNullOrWhitespace()
        {
            var sender = new TestSendTelegramMessage
            {
                BotId = null,
                ApiKey = "apikey",
                ChannelId = "channel"
            };

            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => sender.SendMessageChunkPublic("message", 1, 1));
            Assert.Equal("Telegram Bot ID is required and not set", ex.Message);

            sender.BotId = "   ";
            ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => sender.SendMessageChunkPublic("message", 1, 1));
            Assert.Equal("Telegram Bot ID is required and not set", ex.Message);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task SendMessageChunk_ThrowsException_WhenApiKeyIsNullOrWhitespace()
        {
            var sender = new TestSendTelegramMessage
            {
                BotId = "botid",
                ApiKey = null,
                ChannelId = "channel"
            };

            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => sender.SendMessageChunkPublic("message", 1, 1));
            Assert.Equal("Telegram API Key is required and not set", ex.Message);

            sender.ApiKey = "   ";
            ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => sender.SendMessageChunkPublic("message", 1, 1));
            Assert.Equal("Telegram API Key is required and not set", ex.Message);
        }

        // We cannot mock HttpClient.GetAsync easily because it is not virtual and no seam was applied.
        // So we test that the method runs without throwing when valid parameters are set.
        [Fact]
        public async Task SendMessageChunk_CompletesWithoutException_WithValidParameters()
        {
            var sender = new TestSendTelegramMessage
            {
                BotId = "botid",
                ApiKey = "apikey",
                ChannelId = "channel",
                TopicId = null
            };

            // We expect no exception thrown, but the actual HTTP call will fail or succeed depending on network.
            // This test mainly covers the code path up to and including the GetAsync call.
            await sender.SendMessageChunkPublic("test message", 1, 1);
        }
    }
}

using System;

using Xunit;

namespace Duplicati.Tests.Library.Modules.Builtin
{
    public class SendTelegramMessageTests
    {
        // We cannot access private fields or methods directly, so we test the public interface and error conditions.

        [Fact]
        public async Task SendMessageChunk_ThrowsException_WhenBotIdIsNullOrWhitespace()
        {
            var sender = new SendTelegramMessageWrapper(null, "apikey", "channel", null);
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => sender.SendMessageChunkWrapper("message", 1, 1));
            Assert.Equal("Telegram Bot ID is required and not set", ex.Message);

            sender = new SendTelegramMessageWrapper("   ", "apikey", "channel", null);
            ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => sender.SendMessageChunkWrapper("message", 1, 1));
            Assert.Equal("Telegram Bot ID is required and not set", ex.Message);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task SendMessageChunk_ThrowsException_WhenApiKeyIsNullOrWhitespace()
        {
            var sender = new SendTelegramMessageWrapper("botid", null, "channel", null);
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => sender.SendMessageChunkWrapper("message", 1, 1));
            Assert.Equal("Telegram API Key is required and not set", ex.Message);

            sender = new SendTelegramMessageWrapper("botid", "   ", "channel", null);
            ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<Exception>(() => sender.SendMessageChunkWrapper("message", 1, 1));
            Assert.Equal("Telegram API Key is required and not set", ex.Message);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task SendMessageChunk_CompletesWithoutException_WithValidParameters()
        {
            var sender = new SendTelegramMessageWrapper("botid", "apikey", "channel", null);
            await sender.SendMessageChunkWrapper("test message", 1, 1);
        }

        // Wrapper class to expose private members for testing
        private class SendTelegramMessageWrapper : SendTelegramMessage
        {
            public SendTelegramMessageWrapper(string botid, string apikey, string channelId, string topicId)
            {
                SetPrivateField("m_botid", botid);
                SetPrivateField("m_apikey", apikey);
                SetPrivateField("m_channelId", channelId);
                SetPrivateField("m_topicId", topicId);
            }

            public Task SendMessageChunkWrapper(string message, int partNumber, int totalParts)
            {
                var method = typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetMethod("SendMessageChunk", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (method == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("SendMessageChunk method not found");
                return (Task)method.Invoke(this, new object[] { message, partNumber, totalParts });
            }

            private void SetPrivateField(string fieldName, object value)
            {
                var field = typeof(SendTelegramMessage).GetField(fieldName, System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (field == null) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Field {fieldName} not found");
                field.SetValue(this, value);
            }
        }
    }
}
